{
  "version": "1.49.0",
  "updatedAt": "2026-07-09",
  "standards": [
    {
      "id": "ui.form.dialog.backdrop.blur-no-white-overlay",
      "title": "Dialog Backdrop Blur Without White Overlay",
      "value": "all in-app dialogs and confirmation modals on /client-components (save, duplicate, delete, edit, unsaved-changes, preview, new layout, style/class editors) must render through DesignerDialog using native HTML dialog.showModal() so blur is applied on ::backdrop in the browser top layer; dialog element must use class designer-dialog-native (DESIGNER_DIALOG_BACKDROP_CLASS); canonical CSS in src/index.css: background-color rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12) and backdrop-filter blur(4px) only — light blur, no saturate(), do not increase blur radius; do not use div-based overlays (e.g. bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-sm) or opaque white/gray/slate scrims as substitutes; reuse DesignerDialog for new dialogs, do not create parallel modal shells",
      "appliesTo": [
        "all dialogs",
        "confirmation modals",
        "component designer dialogs",
        "duplicate dialogs",
        "delete dialogs",
        "save dialogs",
        "preview dialogs",
        "edit dialogs"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.form.dialog.body.edge-aligned-white",
      "title": "DesignerDialog Body Edge-Aligned White Surface",
      "value": "DesignerDialog default body (bg-surface-workspace p-[15px] inside px-[15px] shell) must not be used as-is because it creates side gutters with color mismatch; every DesignerDialog body must pass bodyClassName !bg-white !p-0 -mx-[15px] (plus flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-hidden only for full-height dialogs) and wrap content in an inner bg-white p-[15px] host so body aligns with header/footer; reference NewLayoutDialog.tsx and DesignerDraftDialog.tsx; do not expose bg-surface-workspace in body side gutters",
      "appliesTo": [
        "DesignerDialog",
        "component designer dialogs",
        "new layout dialog",
        "duplicate dialogs",
        "save dialogs",
        "edit dialogs",
        "delete dialogs",
        "preview dialogs"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.button.split-button.standard",
      "title": "Split Button Standard",
      "value": "all split/dropdown toolbar buttons must use AppSplitButton (src/shared/ui/AppSplitButton.tsx); reference DesignerViewportControls.tsx; modes: dropdown-only (unified trigger) or primary+menu (default action + chevron); sizes: compact h-7 for Component Designer toolbars, sm h-8 for page toolbars; use semantic intent (utility, create, etc.); menu panel/items via SPLIT_BUTTON_MENU_PANEL_CLASS and SplitButtonMenuItem; compound controls with secondary non-menu action use SPLIT_BUTTON_COMPOUND_CONTAINER_CLASS with internal border-l divider",
      "appliesTo": [
        "split buttons",
        "dropdown toolbar buttons",
        "primary+menu create buttons",
        "compound toolbar controls"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.responsive.selective",
      "title": "Selective Responsive Platform",
      "value": "desktop-first product with selective mobile polish: Tier M surfaces (auth, CRUD lists, light settings, AI, profile) must work on phone; Tier D workspaces (Component Designer, Git, edge editor, Auto-CRUD wizard, theme studio) are desktop-only — set minViewport:\"desktop\" on route nav (or canonical pageKey in viewportTokens DESKTOP_ONLY_PAGE_KEYS); hide nav below lg via filterAdminShellNavByViewport; deep links render DesktopOnlyGate; use viewportTokens.ts + useViewportTier (phone ≤767, tablet 768–1023, desktop ≥1024); AI panel full-screen on phone; CreateEditModalShell near-fullscreen on phone; settings section select on phone; see docs/standards/ui-core.md §Responsive",
      "appliesTo": [
        "admin shell",
        "route bindings",
        "nav registry",
        "mobile layouts",
        "new routes"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ui.destructive.confirmation.danger-header",
      "title": "Destructive Confirmation Danger Header",
      "value": "delete and other destructive confirmation dialogs must use a rose-tinted danger header band (border-rose-200 bg-rose-50/80, title text-rose-800, icon text-rose-600); admin UI via ConfirmDialogShell/DialogPrimaryHeader tone=danger (default when confirmIntent=destructive) and DIALOG_PRIMARY_HEADER_DANGER_* tokens in surfaceClasses.ts; component designer via DesignerDialog tone=danger; non-delete warning confirms keep tone=default with semantic icon color only",
      "appliesTo": [
        "ConfirmDialogShell",
        "DialogPrimaryHeader",
        "DesignerDialog",
        "delete confirmation modals",
        "destructive confirmation modals"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "component-designer.public-component-name",
      "title": "Component Designer — Public Component Name",
      "value": "outside the Component Designer workspace, identify saved components by folder + name path (<folder>/<component-name>); never expose draft/version ids (e.g. draft-…) in preview URLs or cross-feature APIs; preview uses ?component=<folder>/<name>; experience manifest pageKey remains the component name slug when the platform contract forbids slashes; draft index and draft ids are designer-internal persistence only; reference docs/standards/component-designer.md",
      "appliesTo": [
        "component designer preview",
        "experience manifest",
        "portal navigation",
        "designer route propagation",
        "component-designer API consumers"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ai.vibe.unified-live-runtime",
      "title": "Vibe Coding Unified Live Runtime",
      "value": "no separate execution engine for vibe-generated server or client code; after apply, managed Server Functions under runtime/server-functions/ are immediately available as API from the same Node process; Client Component layouts under runtime/designer/drafts/ render from the same React app via Component Designer; test_server_function and VC-4 run_tests verify on this live runtime — not a new sandbox, sidecar, or per-draft deploy pipeline",
      "appliesTo": [
        "Server Functions",
        "Component Designer",
        "changeSet.service",
        "vibe-coding",
        "run_tests"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ai.vibe.manual-operator-parity",
      "title": "Vibe Coding Manual Operator Parity",
      "value": "AppEndO Agent must simulate admin UI paths — Server Functions via draft_server_function only (canonical functionId folder.name, path /api/{folder}/{name}, disk runtime/server-functions/custom/{folder}.{name}.ts); Component Designer via draft_component_layout; never draft_file_patch under runtime/server-functions/; platform source only via allowlisted draft_file_patch; manual parity rules in vibe-operator-playbook and vibe-server-function shards plus contextAssembly APPENDO_VIBE_PLATFORM_RULES",
      "appliesTo": [
        "draft_server_function",
        "changeSet.service",
        "contextAssembly",
        "vibe-operator-playbook",
        "vibe-server-function",
        "vibe-coding"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "matchCount": 8,
  "truncated": false,
  "maxRules": 10,
  "knowledgeKinds": [
    "STANDARD",
    "BUILDER_GUIDANCE"
  ],
  "agentsMdPointer": "See AGENTS.md hub and docs/standards/INDEX.md for topic shards.",
  "runtimeApi": "/api/project-standards",
  "shardHint": "Pass shard (e.g. ui-grid) to load the full markdown topic file."
}
